entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NativeAOT Follow up issue for the covariant returns scenarios in task-returning methods #136339
  • NativeAOT arm64: (int, int) value-tuple parameter used as a 64-bit array index without zero-extension, so the first store writes out of bounds #136335
    12.0.0
  • Windows x86: legacy DAC ICorDebug stack walk truncates in Mini dumps (aligned 8-byte debug-info read runs past the enumerated range) #136331
  • [release/11.0] Backport needed to fix the ProcessHandles test on musl arm32 #136327
  • [release/11.0][wasm] Build tests cannot restore stable .NET 11 packages after RTM dependency flow #136326

  • SOS.Tests.DiagnosticCommandTests.DumpGcData_ReportsPinningAfterCollection test failing in main in the runtime-diagnostics pipeline #136324
  • Add a stable load-context id to the CoreCLR loader and binder events #136322
  • [API Proposal]: Add ClaimsPrincipal.HasAuthenticatedIdentity #136320
  • [WASM][AOT] Vector.GreaterThan(Vector<float>) masks added as floats with SIMD: wrong result, and LLVMTypeOf assertion when compared #136319
  • Tracking: Move main Linux build hosts to Azure Linux 4 #136318
  • [x86] .NET 10.0.13: access violation in GetTLSIndexForThreadStatic (Internal CLR error 0x80131506), regression from #129785 #136317
  • Windows: legacy PKCS#12 export can return trailing bytes beyond the encoded PFX #136316
    10.0.x
  • ZipArchive Update: changing the attributes of a 7-Zip ZipCrypto entry makes its password stop working #136314
  • Tracking: Migrate Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 infrastructure on main to Azure Linux 4 or Ubuntu 26.04 #136313
  • Obsolete Global Mutexes #136312
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) wrong result when `(m & Vector128.Create(a)) == <zero with side effects>` is folded to `vptest` with a stale memory operand #136306
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) wrong code for `Vector128.GetElement` when the index expression modifies the vector's memory #136305
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) Crash: `Vector512.ConditionalSelect` over `Avx512F.Add` with a non-constant `FloatRoundingMode` #136304
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `X86Base.DivRem` is removed when its result is unused, so the `DivideByZeroException` is lost #136303
    12.0.0
  • NativeAOT: missed devirtualization for isinst #136302

  • [API Proposal]: Allow changing ZstandardEncoder compression quality without recreating the encoder #136294

  • MemoryExtensions.LastIndexOf ignores a custom comparer for bitwise-equatable element types #136281
  • [HTTP] HttpWebRequest Address and redirect #136280
    12.0.0
  • Managed ilasm: a type referenced before its .class declaration loses its implicit base type #136277
  • MemoryExtensions.Sort<TKey, TValue, TComparer>(keys, items, comparer) sorts incorrectly for struct TComparer in .NET 11 #136274
  • [API Proposal]: PathRoot for scoped file access #136273

  • [Mono][WASM][AOT] Request .NET 10 backport of #131880 #136267
